title: bl_land and kbfacts still offer every public function and class they defined before the split
goal: every public top-level function and class bl_land.py and kbfacts.py defined at 43613de1e is still an attribute of its module, or the sprint goal's 'every name kept' is reworded to the names other modules read

run:
import ast, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
miss = []
for m in ("bl_land", "kbfacts"):
    src = subprocess.run(["git", "show", "43613de1e:_tools/" + m + ".py"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    top = [n.name for n in ast.parse(src).body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)) and not n.name.startswith("_")]
    mod = __import__(m)
    miss += [m + "." + x for x in top if not hasattr(mod, x)]
print("public names the split dropped:", len(miss), miss[:10])
sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
